blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it

findings.recommendation: Wait between attempts with an exponential backoff and jitter (for example 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s), so retries are spaced as the operations criterion requires. Today, when a merchant's server is down or overloaded (a 503 or a connection refused), the five attempts land within a few hundred milliseconds: they hammer a server that is already failing, and an outage of even a few seconds exhausts every attempt and drops the event for good. The retry is bounded and idempotent (x-event-id), so only the spacing is missing. Consider also not retrying 4xx responses other than 408/429.
findings.title: Webhook retries fire back to back, with no backoff

findings.recommendation: Use the project's structured logger (src/logger.ts, as src/events.ts does) instead of console.debug: log each failed attempt with fields (eventId, paymentId, attempt, status or error) — including non-ok HTTP responses, which today produce no log line at all — and log the final drop at error level with the event id, payment id and last status. When a merchant endpoint answers 500 five times, the operator today sees only a debug-level prose line with no status and no merchant, and cannot query or alert on dropped webhooks.
findings.title: Failed and dropped deliveries are logged with console.debug in free text, and HTTP errors not at all
